en_how: On a mottled earth-red wall, sawtooth hills, wind-bent trees and scrolling clouds are painted in azurite, malachite, white and ochre, then faded and flaked with a weathering layer; flying apsaras cross the wall each frame with long ribbons drawn as widening sine-wave bands and fluent dark outlines, and from 2.5 s the mural breaks into irregular fragments that crack, peel and tumble away from the centre to reveal a new painting.
